summary: First-run end-to-end testing of BalansPLN. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases passed including all CRUD (categories, transactions, budgets upsert, recurring with idempotency), summary/trend aggregation, and AI chat via emergentintegrations (Claude Sonnet 4.5) returning a Polish reply. No MongoDB _id leaked in any response. Frontend: dashboard, balance hero, month switcher, add-transaction dialog (expense + income), budgets dialog, transactions list, charts and AI chat button all render and respond correctly. One major UX issue found: webpack-dev-server React error overlay surfaces a benign ResizeObserver warning from recharts and blocks all clicks until dismissed.

minor.issue: logger is referenced inside ai_chat (line 386) but the logging.basicConfig + logger = logging.getLogger(...) is declared AFTER the function definition (lines 411-415). Works at runtime due to late binding, but it is a fragile ordering — move logger setup to top of module.

ui_bugs.issue: Webpack/CRA React error overlay pops up with 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications.' and covers the entire viewport. This is a benign warning (recharts ResponsiveContainer triggers it on first paint) but the overlay blocks clicks on AI Chat button, second 'Dodaj transakcję' click, and other UI elements until user presses Escape. Will also show in user's preview deploy.

action_items: Suppress the benign ResizeObserver overlay. Recommended fix in /app/frontend/src/index.js: add a global error handler that swallows messages starting with 'ResizeObserver loop' (window.addEventListener('error', e => { if (e.message && e.message.includes('ResizeObserver loop')) { e.stopImmediatePropagation(); } });) AND also handle 'unhandledrejection'. Alternatively disable react-error-overlay in CRA config / set process.env.DISABLE_NEW_JSX_TRANSFORM / use a webpack overlay config. This is the only blocker for smooth UI use.
(Nice-to-have) Move logger initialization to top of /app/backend/server.py to avoid forward-reference fragility.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: logger declared AFTER ai_chat which uses it. Reorder.
server.py: AI chat path silently raises HTTPException with raw exception string in detail — fine for now but consider sanitizing in production.
Frontend recharts containers should set explicit minWidth/minHeight to silence ResizeObserver warning at the source.
Dashboard.jsx: error handler in loadAll() silently ignores errors — consider showing a toast on load failure.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds 9 default Polish categories on startup; verified. Test created transactions/budgets/recurring with TEST_ prefix and cleaned them up.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is fully working including Claude Sonnet 4.5 AI chat via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY. The only frontend blocker is the dev error overlay from recharts ResizeObserver warning — once suppressed, AI chat dialog, budget dialog, and second transaction creation will be unblocked. Re-run frontend Playwright after the index.js fix to confirm AI chat dialog opens via [data-testid=open-ai-chat-btn] without overlay interception.
rca of the issue: Recharts ResponsiveContainer measures DOM in a microtask using ResizeObserver. When children re-render rapidly during first mount, the browser dispatches a 'ResizeObserver loop completed with undelivered notifications' event. CRA's react-error-overlay treats any uncaught error/unhandledrejection as a fatal overlay, so it hijacks the screen and intercepts pointer events. Mitigation: swallow the specific message in window error/unhandledrejection handler in src/index.js OR ensure the chart container has fixed minHeight.
